why: On head, parsing ['-ab'] with boolean flags a and b, short-option-groups off and unknown-options-as-args on gives {"_":[],"ab":true}, so the unknown '-ab' is set as a new key 'ab' and never reaches argv._; on base it passes through as {"_":["-ab"]}.
